owner: original bg-social-metrics-sync 6h observer, original powerhouse-runtime-scheduler-mux minute39, existing CRO redaction agent
root_cause: After provider-native schema drift correction PR #5546, the existing 6h observer sets healthy true if any verified LinkedIn company metric was linked. It does not check whether EACH provider-proven published experimental variant was successfully passed to original social_metric_snapshots then source-exact social_learning_evaluations and social_learning_applications. A single old metric and Instagram/personal success can hide unrelated mature variant handoff failure. On Nov 9, 5 provider-proven applications existed, 2 evaluated and 3 pending; absence of a post-level SLA was unobserved.
fix: Append read-only bounded per-experiment audit to existing bg-social-metrics-sync and its already-imported linked-company-analytics helper. Only exact company tenant/channel/URN and provider org observation >=24h post and <=8d accepted; exact source_event in original evaluation with original application-ID. After 78h metric missing and after 84h evaluation/ack missing become HANDOFF_OVERDUE and veto overall healthy. Pending age is non-green but not outage. Original 6h runtime event stores evidence, owner, repair action; no extra cron, fallback sender, new table or permissions.
prevention: No service-level GREEN for full experiment flow on HTTP200, account-level provider freshness, linked_count>0, or successful metrics for another post. The exact downstream post+application+provider event must join at correct maturity; incomplete mature stage changes original run to nonhealthy and gives sole repair owner; no duplicate execution or false revenue/causal uplift. Keep incoming posts pending until evidence-maturity horizon and original executor running.

invariants: no artificial zero or causal lift

terminal_rule: Protected Required+CodeQL, exact PR commit+merge, deploy existing Edge with same shared helpers, independent source parity and original six-hour event readback. Repeat on an overdue genuine provider experiment to verify alert; only a natural next content generation with source-linked application proves full learn-and-improve.
